newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest to start continuous BUX calculation.
newsitem.headline: Budapest to start continuous BUX calculation.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Thursday that it will start a continuous calculation of the BUX index effective April 1.
Now the official BUX index of the BSE is calculated once a day, following the close of trading.

As an additional change, the official daily BUX index will be calculated based on closing prices instead of the current system when the BUX index is calculated from average prices, the BSE said in a statement.
The BSE will also publish the opening, the daily low and high values of the BUX index, it added.
